concerns.text: The spec (FR-001) requires using the ACE‑Ego‑0 dataset, but Task T001 downloads EPIC‑KITCHENS‑100. This narrows the data source and weakens the functional requirement.

Spec edge case mandates imputation with dataset‑mean values (or segment exclusion) when static feature extraction fails. No task mentions implementing this imputation or exclusion logic, violating the acceptance criteria.

SC‑005 calls for measuring the CPU‑time speed‑up against the ACE‑Ego‑0 baseline (5 min CPU per hour) while also enforcing an absolute limit. Task T013 only checks absolute limits and does not record or compare the speed‑up, thus dropping a required measurement.
